pins.title: Beach Maths for Kids: A One-Minute Wave Counting Game
pins.description: How can you turn a beach visit into a counting game? From a safe, dry spot with a grown-up, tally the waves that reach shore in one minute. Repeat three times and compare the totals. Try the Wave Pattern Mission in the free ocean activities guide.
